en.summary: FreeVideo now runs on Apple silicon Macs.
changes: Mac preview: FreeVideo runs on Apple silicon Macs with macOS 14 or later.
A short product version is now shown in the launcher and creative workspace. The build number remains available in version details.
Update reminders include release notes in your selected language: English or Simplified Chinese.
Open Version & release notes at any time, including after updating or while offline, to read the notes included with your installed version.

zh.summary: FreeVideo 推出 Apple 芯片 Mac 预览版。
changes: Mac 预览版：支持 macOS 14 及以上的 Apple 芯片 Mac。
启动器和创作面板显示简短产品版本，构建号可在版本详情中查看。
更新提醒附带更新说明，跟随界面语言显示中文或英文。
随时打开「版本与更新说明」，更新后或离线时也能查看当前版本自带的说明。
